notes:
# 1.06
- Majestic platform update: new server build + js-module (matches client **1.19.9**). Press UPDATE and you're on the current version — no reinstall

# 1.05
- Hair bases: the **tint now applies live** — turn Hair color and the fade recolors instantly, no need to scroll the decal back and forth
- Fixed: changing appearance while the hairstyle is hidden no longer brings the hair back over the fade

# 1.04
- Fixed: with the debug board open, **T and M stopped working** — the board is an overlay now, so chat and the menu open over it as usual (that's how you reach "Close clothes debug")

# 1.03
- **Clothes debug board is now a toggle**: `/debug` opens it and it stays open — through chat, through the M menu, while you walk around. `/debug` again (or **Close clothes debug**, shown in red in the menu once it's open) closes it. Pressing Esc on the board just releases the cursor so you can move, the board stays
- Tattoo browser: **Hair: shown / hidden** switch — check a hair base with and without the hairstyle, and see how the tint colors it (hair is hidden automatically when you enter the Hair base category)
- **Encrypted packs are read now** (NG and AES): tattoos, hair bases and the real DLC name are picked up from any pack, not just from unencrypted ones — no more repacking by hand
- **Everything is written automatically before each server start**: the manager rebuilds `dlcWhitelist` in server.toml from the packs you actually have (using the DLC name from setup2, which is what the engine requires) and prepares the decorations catalog for the server. Drop a pack — press START — it works
- **Closing the manager now really closes everything**: QUIT, the window X, Alt+F4 — the game server is killed and the manager leaves no background process behind (the watchdog used to be disabled in the desktop app, so a backend could hang around)
- **DLC validator**: every pack is checked before the server starts — valid packs show green `pack OK (encryption, entries, size)`, broken/unreadable ones show red `ERROR READING` with the reason and are auto-disabled so the server still boots (a corrupt archive used to kill it silently)
- Tattoo browser: the ped now **undresses while you browse** (clothes come back when you leave the menu), and in the Hair base category the hairstyle is removed too — fades were drawn under the hair, that's why they seemed invisible
- New `/creator` command — jumps straight into the appearance creator
- Custom tattoo/hair-base packs are now read properly: the scanner parses the RPF table of contents and decompresses the overlays XML (packs built with compression were silently ignored), and both `GENDER_MALE` and plain `MALE` formats are recognized

# 1.02
- **Tattoos & hair bases** — new M-menu section: browse all 1691 vanilla tattoos by body zone with live preview, plus 195 hair base decals (the fade layers under hairstyles). Add/remove/clear, saved with your outfit per gender
- Custom packs with tattoos/overlays are picked up automatically and appear in the same browser
- Weapons: **Custom hash...** — spawn any weapon by name, decimal or 0x hash
- Makeup studio: **Eye color (lens)** — all 32 native lens variants, applied instantly and saved with your outfit
- Makeup studio: **mouse wheel** now zooms the camera in and out (Q/E still work)
- `/gender` is now a simple toggle — just type it to switch to the opposite gender, no more `m`/`f` argument (the M menu has a single "Switch gender" entry too)

# 1.01
- **CUSTOM CODE mode** — new button in the header. Turn it ON and build your own server: write features in `resources/core` (server/client/UI) — updates will never overwrite your code. Majestic platform files (server binaries, modules) keep updating as usual. Turning it OFF returns full updates and replaces changed code with the released version.

# 1.0
- First release — welcome!
- **In-game dev HUD**: chat with command suggestions (`/` + **Tab**, arrow-up history, Russian layout recognized), red alert for unknown/failed commands, M menu, clothes debug board, makeup studio with a fully frozen ped, noclip, photo mode, prop attach, draggable and scalable interface, Roboto Mono everywhere
- **Server Manager**: drag & drop DLC packs (rename / disable / delete), facial_overlays.meta upload and delete, server start/stop with colored log
- **Updates**: when a new version is out the header blinks green **UPDATE** — click it, read the notes, press **UPDATE NOW**. Server binaries update remotely too, no reinstall
- **Installer**: one file, pick a folder — everything downloads from GitHub
